documents.title: Master services agreement
documents.text:
Master services agreement — Esker Partners (fictional).
In this document "EPH" means Esker Partners. Esker Partners reports annual price escalator of 6.8% for FY2025. Esker Partners reports uptime commitment of 82.57% for FY2024 on a adjusted (management definition) basis. Esker Partners reports term years of 6 years. Esker Partners reports insurance cover of $8.3m for FY2025 on a reported basis. For Esker Partners, the data residency obligation is read as: customer data stays within the EEA. For Esker Partners, the renewal is: expires at the end of the initial term unless renewed in writing.

documents.title: Amendment letter
documents.text:
Amendment letter — Esker Partners (fictional).
Esker Partners reports annual price escalator of 5.5% for FY2025. Esker Partners reports uptime commitment of 99.58% for FY2024 on a reported basis. Esker Partners reports liability cap of $1.9m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Esker Partners reports termination notice period of 77.154 days for FY2025. For Esker Partners, the data residency obligation is read as: customer data may be processed by approved sub-processors worldwide. For Esker Partners, the renewal is: renews automatically for successive 12-month terms.
